caption: The drawing features a weather vane consisting of a metallic-looking figure of a standing cow with two pointed horns and a short tail, facing to the left. The cow is depicted in a silvery-blue tone and has the label "T41" marked in large, bold, dark characters on its side. The animal stands atop a horizontal rod, which is attached to a vertical pole. Below the cow, attached to the pole, is a set of directional indicators for north, south, east, and west, with the letters shown in a stylized font and rendered in a similar silvery-blue color. Further down the pole is a round ornament with a conical base, ending with a fringed or spiked decoration. The background of the image is a plain, off-white color, and in the lower right corner is the printed name "HERBERT BARNARD."
title: Weather Vane
